messages.subject: Saudi Arabia Executive Profile | Corporate Affairs, ESG & Strategic Leadership
messages.body:
Dear Saudi German Health Recruitment Team,

I am sharing my executive profile for senior corporate opportunities in Saudi Arabia spanning corporate and external affairs, government relations, ESG and sustainability, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships and country-facing leadership.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My mandate covers senior government and regulatory engagement, ESG, corporate affairs, social performance, executive communications and cross-functional execution within a major multinational operation.

For Saudi German Health, my experience is most relevant to corporate services, external affairs, stakeholder strategy, sustainability, strategic programs and senior cross-functional leadership where institutional relationships and disciplined execution support growth.

I am pursuing Director, Senior Director, Head and country-facing leadership mandates across Saudi Arabia and the wider GCC. My Saudi/GCC executive CV is attached. I am internationally mobile, available with 30 days notice and open to employer-supported relocation.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc. (Zijin Mining Group)
